archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tinted with Custom User Palette)
emotion_and_vibe: Authoritative, secure, clear, objective, modern, and highly legible. The design must feel like a high-end command center for compliance officers.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) for cards to prevent text collision. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between structural elements.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Paragraphs, labels, and dense content must be left-aligned. Use the F-pattern layout with the primary North Star metric in the top-left quadrant.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky top header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-gray-200. Left sidebar for complex modular navigation.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), no shadow by default. Hover state: shadow-sm, -translate-y-[1px]. Maximum 8px border-radius (rounded-lg).
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#0F5156] text-white hover:bg-[#136F72]. Secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50.
components.tables: Sticky headers, minimal zebra striping or clean border-b, dense padding (py-2 px-3) for readability, right-aligned numbers.
components.inputs: Shadcn/UI standards, customized with 8px radius, border-gray-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F5156]/50. Left-aligned labels.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Assign accents (Soft Blue, Light Green, Muted Orange) for data series. Never use generic 'vibrating' colors.

motion_and_interaction.animations: Minimalist micro-interactions. Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for hovers.
motion_and_interaction.states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states MUST have higher contrast.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes. Support prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast ratios mandatory.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly functional and aligned to text size for developer tools and dense dashboards.

images.description: High-end abstract data visualization, geometric shapes representing compliance and security frameworks intersecting. Deep teal and dark gray tones with subtle muted orange highlights.
A close-up, macro shot of pristine architectural frosted glass intersecting with dark slate and deep teal elements. Minimalist, premium, corporate security concept.
Abstract lines and graphs with glowing green and blue effects. Use for placeholder complex charts or modal backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard pure Tailwind for marketing/auth pages. Use deeply customized Shadcn/UI for the dashboard components.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn Dropdown, Select, and Calendar components.
Enforce the 'Bento Grid Protocol: Mode B' for dashboard layouts. Use subgrid if necessary.
Every page must have a visible navigation bar on desktop.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.
Implement high-contrast text ratios for all elements. Avoid placing light gray text on white backgrounds.
Use Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for layout structure, but always utilize Shadcn logic for interactive components.
Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Make sure the Primary Palette maps to the teal/blue-green hex codes provided.
Ensure the final application is output in .js/.jsx, not .tsx.
Design specifically for dense data display: apply progressive disclosure, sticky headers for tables, and F-pattern arrangements.
